inputs.name: fileName.path
inputs.description: The path whose last '/'-separated segment fileName returns; a path with no '/' is returned whole, and a backslash is not a separator. It matters because the SQL migration check and the '+server.ts' handler check both use that base name.

inputs.name: typeScriptStem.path
inputs.description: The path whose last segment typeScriptStem returns after removing one trailing .ts, .tsx, .js or .jsx extension. It matters for naming rules that compare a file's stem, and endings such as .json or .mts are kept.

inputs.name: fileNameFinding.file
inputs.description: The audited file whose relativePath is copied into the finding's path; fileNameFinding reads no other AuditFile field. It matters because the finding is reported against that repository-relative path.

inputs.name: fileNameFinding.message
inputs.description: The text the calling rule supplies, which fileNameFinding copies unchanged into the finding's message field. It matters because it is the only explanation a reader sees for the failed name, and the function does not check its wording or length.
examples: Model files should be named <PascalName>.ts or <PascalName>.types.ts.
Migration files should use lowercase kebab-case or snake_case names.

inputs.name: isPascalCase.value
inputs.description: The candidate name checked against the PascalCase pattern: one uppercase ASCII letter, then any ASCII letters or digits. It matters for model, class and component names; an empty string, a hyphen, an underscore or a leading lowercase letter fails the check.

inputs.name: isCamelCase.value
inputs.description: The candidate name checked against the camelCase pattern: one lowercase ASCII letter, then any ASCII letters or digits. It matters for function, utility and store names; an empty string, a hyphen, an underscore or a leading capital fails the check.

inputs.name: isKebabCase.value
inputs.description: The candidate stem checked against the kebab-case pattern: lowercase ASCII letters or digits in groups joined by single hyphens. It matters for seed-data file stems; capitals, underscores, leading or trailing hyphens, doubled hyphens and an empty string fail the check.

inputs.name: escapeRegExp.value
inputs.description: The text to escape: each dot, asterisk, plus, question mark, caret, dollar sign, brace, parenthesis, pipe, square bracket and backslash gets a backslash in front. It matters when a name is embedded in a RegExp pattern, and hyphens, slashes, letters and digits are left unchanged.

outputs.name: fileName
outputs.description: The last '/'-separated segment of the input path, or the whole input when it has no '/'. It matters because the SQL migration check and the '+server.ts' handler check both use it as the base name; a path ending in '/' gives an empty string.

outputs.name: typeScriptStem
outputs.description: The last path segment with one trailing .ts, .tsx, .js or .jsx removed, so 'Customer.types.ts' gives 'Customer.types'. It matters for naming rules that compare a file's stem, and a name with no such extension is returned unchanged.

outputs.name: fileNameFinding
outputs.description: The finding for the input file, with path set to its relativePath, rule set to 'file-name-pattern' and message set to the input message. It matters because the audit reports the finding under that repository-relative path and the fixed rule name.

examples.message: Model files should be named <PascalName>.ts or <PascalName>.types.ts.

outputs.name: isPascalCase
outputs.description: True when the value is one uppercase ASCII letter followed by any ASCII letters or digits, and false otherwise. It matters for rules that accept model, class and component names; hyphens, underscores, spaces and a leading lowercase letter make it false.

outputs.name: isCamelCase
outputs.description: True when the value is one lowercase ASCII letter followed by any ASCII letters or digits, and false otherwise. It matters for rules that accept function, utility and store names; hyphens, underscores and a leading capital make it false.

outputs.name: isKebabCase
outputs.description: True when the value is lowercase ASCII letters or digits in groups joined by single hyphens, and false otherwise. It matters for seed-data file stems; capitals, underscores, doubled hyphens and leading or trailing hyphens make it false.

outputs.name: escapeRegExp
outputs.description: The input with a backslash placed before each dot, asterisk, plus, question mark, caret, dollar sign, brace, parenthesis, pipe, square bracket and backslash character. It matters when a name is embedded in a RegExp source, and hyphens, slashes, letters and digits are returned unchanged.
